text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm. Looking at recent race results, 
this Umamusume is the one to watch in the 
next race...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Huh... This person's hair color... Could 
it be...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...I've really faded quite a bit, haven't 
I.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Geh! The line for the hairdryers is 
insane~. I'm so glad I used one early~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, today was the yuzu bath day after 
all~ Plus, the public bath itself was 
amazing...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Chrono-chan. Yahoo~ Are you waiting 
for the hair dryer too~?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no! It's just... your hair color has 
faded quite a bit, I noticed.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I getcha~! ...Yeah, I had a phase like 
that too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's pretty surprising at first, isn't it? 
Like, "Wait, what's happening to me?!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I totally getcha! Like, depending on the 
time, pics of ya as a kid make ya look 
like a whole different person!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That sounds familiar to me too. 
...And besides.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The win rate in snowball fights goes up.

text_block_list.name: Hishimi & Tamamo
text_block_list.text: Ah~, that happens all the time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I understand completely... How many times 
has Gold Ship ambushed me from the snow 
like that...?!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: A-Ahahaha...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Also, at the salon, people often tell me, 
"I'm so jealous you don't even need 
bleach!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. That happens often. ...From my 
perspective, I actually envy smooth, sleek 
black hair like Brian's.”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"This is pretty much my one and only 
unique trait, so I guess I should thank 
God for it~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I could've even made it my summer 
independent research project: "On the 
Color Changes in Umamusume Hair"~ or 
something.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
! ...T-That sounds wonderful! Maybe I'll 
give it a try too...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ah, Curren just had a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're at it, Chrono-chan, you 
should take photos every day starting 
today too♪"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Huh? A-A photo?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Wouldn't it be wonderful if we 
recorded it like a diary instead of just 
plain research?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, that sounds great. ...Wouldn't it 
also become a piece of your own racing 
history?"

On a pleasant, sunny day. While taking a 
stroll around the academy grounds to clear 
my head...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Dance more like a fighting fish! Leap 
like a flying fish! Strike like fresh 
sashimi!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm, so very cute♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Oh! So this is where you were doing it 
today! Chrono's photo shoot.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Golshi's playing director again 
today, huh? ...Betta, flying fish, 
sashimi. Now I'm craving sushi.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Are you really that simple?!
choice_data_list:
Uh, ummm... what's this about Chrono's 
photo shoot?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: U-Um... to be precise, it's my hair's.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look. Chrono's hair color's gradually 
turnin' white, yeah? So since we got the 
chance, we figured we'd keep a record of 
it.
choice_data_list: Ah, I see! That sounds fun.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay! And so, here's our photo for 
today♪

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much...! ...Hehe, 
naturally there's no change yet, though.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, obviously. If you wanna turn that 
white, how about we head to the North Pole 
right now for a snowball fight?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
N-N-No! I-I'm fine...! I'll let nature 
take its course...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Still... hehe. If it does turn all white, 
I'd be so happy if you'd have a snowball 
fight with me.
choice_data_list:
Let's make the outfit white when that time 
comes.

I'm looking forward to seeing the color 
change.

I'm looking forward to seeing the color 
change, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Still... hehe. If it does turn all white, 
I'd be so happy if you'd have a snowball 
fight with me.
choice_data_list:
Let's make the outfit white when that time 
comes.

I'm looking forward to seeing the color 
change.

I'm looking forward to seeing the color 
change, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Let's make the shoelaces white while 
we're at it, then~! With udon noodles!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Huh!? U-Udon...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Are you stupid?! Why the heck are you 
takin' it seriously too?!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ah! I-I-I'm so sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it. ...More importantly, 
why don't we head to the cafeteria? Let's 
go have a seafood bowl together.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah! There you are, Chrono-chan~. I brought 
that thing you asked for~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. It's my "Independent Research 
Notebook"~. When I was little, I took 
notes on how hair color changes~.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you for going out of your way! 
I'll gladly take a look...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Everyone is truly so kind...♪
